client_letter.subject: Your Policy Renewal Update
client_letter.body:
Dear Derek P Halstead Construction Co Inc,

Your Contractors Special Policy will renew on September 24, 2026, with no change to the premium of $1,879.

Key changes include the removal of the CP 382 — NY Anti Arson Amendment and the DNCANY — Important Notice Exclusion - Communicable Disease. We are confirming these changes with the insurer.

We will discuss any additional points of interest once we receive the insurer’s confirmation.

Thank you,
Account Manager (demo)
Fideon Demo Agency
